page.body:
How to Acquire and Deploy PropertyList Credits


Welcome to the PropertyList Credit System. 

Unlike traditional legacy portals that lock you into expensive monthly retainers, PropertyList operates on a transparent, "Pay-As-You-Go" infrastructure. 

Your core operational tools - including the Smart MLS, CRM, Branded MicroSite, and unlimited property listings - are completely free forever. Our Credit System is designed strictly for deploying "Power Tools" and premium visibility enhancements, ensuring you only pay for features when a specific deal requires it.

Here is how to earn, purchase, and strategically use your PropertyList Credits.

1. The Value of a Credit

The financial model is straightforward and designed for maximum flexibility:
*(Please note: Purchases are non-refundable).*

Base Value: 1 Credit = €1.

No Expiration: Purchased credits do not expire. You use them at your own pace.

No Hidden Fees: There are no tied contracts, no setup fees, and no cancellation fees. 

2. How to Acquire Credits

There are three ways to add credits to your agency's digital wallet:

🎁 The Welcome Bonus (Free): To support the migration of professional standards, every new Verified Agency automatically receives 20 FREE Credits upon successful onboarding. This allows you to immediately test our premium features.

Pay-As-You-Go Purchasing: You can purchase credits as needed directly through your dashboard. We offer discounts for bulk credit purchases.

Monthly Subscriptions: (coming soon) While the core MLS is free, agencies can opt for a monthly subscription which includes a recurring allocation of credits for platform use, granting access to premium features such as opening direct leads from the public portal.

3. How to Deploy Your Credits

Credits are used to activate our AI Utility Agents, expand your digital footprint, and boost your listings. Here is the current deployment structure:


Marketing & Visibility Tools

Feature a Listing (MLS): Boost a property to the top of the MLS search results for maximum agent visibility. Cost: 10 Credits for 72 hours. 
XML Website Export: Seamlessly sync all 6,000+ MLS listings directly to your own website. Cost: 35 Credits per month (or a discounted €250 per year).


AI & Analytics Tools

AI Market Analysis: Generate a comprehensive, branded Comparative Market Analysis (CMA) report using real registry data and our AI Property Research Agent. Cost: 5 Credits per report (Special Offer). 

(Note: Every agent receives 2 free analyses to test the system).

As the public portal expands, credits will also be used to unlock:

  • Opening Direct Leads from the public portal.
  • Featuring your agency profile or public portal listings.
  • Deploying AI Virtual Tours and AI Chatbots.



Strategic Advice for Agents:

By treating your credits as an investment rather than a subscription, you retain total control over your agency's budget. Use your free tools to build your portfolio, and deploy your credits to unblock specific sales, impress demanding vendors with AI reports, and instantly expand your website's inventory.
